Identifying RPC handlers that trigger outbound HTTP requests to user-configured URLs, likely through webhook mechanisms. Need to locate the specific handler methods and the single convergence function before delivery.

Searching for API handlers that trigger webhooks. The convergence point is likely a dispatch function such as webhook.Post, PostAsync, or a generic Dispatcher.
I'll trace RPC handlers that fire outbound HTTP to a user-configured URL and find where those paths converge.

I am tracing RPC handlers that call DispatchMemo*Webhook. The convergence function appears to be the one calling webhook.PostAsync.

I am reading memo_service_webhooks.go to identify all callers of the Dispatch functions.
Tracing all RPC handlers that transitively call `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` through `memo_update_helpers.go` to identify outbound HTTP request paths.
Tracing callers of `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` and `DispatchMemo*` functions to identify outbound HTTP request paths.
Shell grep with --include may fail on directories. I'll try a different approach.

Four RPC handlers can transitively trigger outbound HTTP requests to user-configured URLs. These are CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, and SetMemoAttachments. They converge through the dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects function.

SetMemoRelations and CreateMemoComment also trigger outbound HTTP. All paths converge at `webhook.PostAsync` before delivery.

The exact path is `internal/webhook/webhook.go` for `PostAsync`. `Post` performs the actual delivery. `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` was considered but rejected because it omits `CreateMemoComment`.

Other outbound HTTP paths were considered but dismissed. Identity provider OAuth2 endpoints, link preview fetchers, and S3 presigns are either admin-configured or not webhook-style URLs. Webhooks remain the only clear user-configured outbound destination.

message.text:
SSO handlers call admin-configured OAuth2 token and userinfo URLs. An httpgetter function fetches HTML meta. These paths converge before delivery.

Memo mutation handlers trigger outbound webhook requests. CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations, and CreateMemoComment all converge at `webhook.PostAsync` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go` before delivery. CreateMemoComment routes through `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook`; the rest pass through `DispatchMemo*` and `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`.

`httpgetter.GetHTMLMeta` also triggers outbound HTTP to user-provided URLs, such as link previews. SSO sign-in handlers call external identity provider endpoints.

Webhook handlers such as CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations, and CreateMemoComment can trigger outbound HTTP requests to user-configured URLs. These paths converge at webhook.PostAsync and then Post.

GetLinkMetadata and BatchGetLinkMetadata fetch HTML metadata from user-provided URLs. Their paths converge at fetchHTMLMeta and httpgetter.GetHTMLMeta.

SignIn and CreateLinkedIdentity exchange tokens against admin or user-configured identity provider URLs. These paths converge at ExchangeToken and UserInfo.

GetLinkMetadata uses a URL provided directly in the request body, not a separately configured endpoint. Identity provider URLs are instance-level configuration. The single convergence function is `webhook.PostAsync` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`, which all webhook paths share before `Post` delivers the request.

h06.
CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations, CreateMemoComment; PostAsync — internal/webhook/webhook.go

Those RPC handlers dispatch memo webhooks (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`, `memo_attachment_service.go`, `memo_relation_service.go`, `memo_service_comments.go`). Created/updated/deleted paths go through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`; comments call `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook`. Both enqueue via `webhook.PostAsync` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go`) before `Post` sends the HTTP request to the user-configured URL.
